hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT: CARE upgraded Arvind Limited to AA Stable from AA- (25 Aug 2026) and its subsidiary Arvind Envisol to A- from BBB+ (12 Oct 2026). Dossier: Q1 revenue +24.6% but PAT +0.4%; unusual items 25.4% of PBT.

risk.cycle: HIGH: textile/apparel margins cyclical and stock +78% in 12m
risk.order_firmness: MEDIUM: Envisol order book concentrated in a few large orders (CARE)

thesis: Arvind's revenue is growing +24.6% with credit ratings improving, but profit has not followed: PAT +0.4%, 35% tax rate and unusual items at 25% of PBT mean quality of earnings is unclear. EBITDA margin is 9.6% (textile-level), the stock is up 78% in 12 months, and 32x TTM P/E is high for a cyclical. A rating upgrade is a credit event, not a demand or pricing inflection.
